description: How a cache or artifact of a directory (saving it, restoring it, or downloading an artifact into it) treats the volumes mounted below it. Both agents are checked against this one file: internal/agent (host, isolated and native) and internal/k8sagent. Edit it only when the rule deliberately changes, and both sides must keep passing. The workspace is /workspace.

relative.description: two volumes at relative mount paths

artifact: artifact path "." excludes volume "go-cache" mounted at ".ucd-cache/go": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
artifact path "." excludes volume "tools" mounted at "tools": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it

cleanWorkspace.description: cleanWorkspace on a volume mounted at the workspace root, with other volumes mounted below it: every root file is removed, the directories on the path to a nested mount point lose their other children too, and the nested volumes keep every byte. Both agents are held to this: the host agent wipes before it mounts, the Kubernetes agent has to skip the mount points itself because the pod mounts them into the container that does the wiping.
